scope: Additive Diggy L11-15 TH18 dated-level supplement and L1-15 combat contract audit; no incomplete Core actor is enabled.
game_version: Official August 2026 TH18 update; GiBiArena game-file table dated 2026-09-01, exact client build unpublished; current deterministic burrow and stun timing unverified.

sources.title: Full Release Notes
facts: Diggy travels underground beside its Hero, emerges to stun and attack defenses, favors the Hero's target, targets ground, and searches for a new Hero after its assigned Hero is knocked out.
sources.limitations: Burrow/visibility, target selection, Hero reassignment order, stun duration and tick timing are not specified.

sources.title: Get Ready for Ranked! - Update
facts: Diggy's stun now applies to all targets, including defending Heroes and Clan Castle Troops.
sources.limitations: The phrase does not define air targetability or stun duration, immunity, refresh and effect ordering.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
facts: Combat logic for underground units was reworked; the release says Diggy and Miners will behave more consistently against Skeleton hordes.
sources.limitations: The revised underground collision and acquisition predicates are not published.

sources.title: August Update
facts: Diggy L11-15 were added for TH18.
sources.limitations: No numeric stats or stun time are published.

sources.title: What's New?
facts: TH18 and Pet House 12 unlock L11-15, HP rises with levels, and stun improves at L15.
sources.limitations: No exact HP, DPS or stun seconds are published.

sources.title: Diggy: Kosten, Zeiten und Stufen — Clash of Clans
sources.version: Game-file data dated 2026-09-01, processed 2026-09-03; exact client build unpublished
facts: The page publishes L11-15 HP 5150, 5300, 5450, 5600, 5750; DPS 155, 160, 165, 170, 175; dark-elixir costs, upgrade times, and TH18 requirements. It identifies its game-file data date and processing date.
sources.limitations: The page does not publish its exact client build, damage per hit, stun durations or the underlying source-file hash. Its values are preserved in a separate local observation with SHA-256.

sources.title: Pinned Diggy Home Village Pet record
facts: The frozen raw record ends at L10 and declares 1.1-second attack cadence and 0.8-tile range.
sources.limitations: It predates L11-15 and the 2026 underground logic rework; no current stun or Hero reassignment timing can be derived.

derivations.result: Supplement data-only HP, DPS, upgrade costs and times
derivations.method: Transcribe dated game-file table into a SHA-pinned local observation; convert whole days and half-day to integer seconds; TH18 and Pet House 12 corroborated by official support.

rejected_inferences.rule: Infer current Diggy L11-15 damage per hit from old 1.1-second attack cadence
rejected_inferences.reason: The cadence is from a pre-update payload, and the current attack or stun phase is not verified.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the L15 stun improvement as a sourced 3.5-second effect
rejected_inferences.reason: Supercell confirms an improvement without a number; a secondary report offers 3.5 seconds but no build-pinned measurement or complete refresh and ordering contract.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use the old underground and target rules after the February 2026 rework
rejected_inferences.reason: The official rework names changed skeleton interactions but omits the new collision and acquisition predicates.

rejected_inferences.rule: Select the nearest surviving Hero after Diggy's assigned Hero falls
rejected_inferences.reason: The official reassignment description does not define priority, distance, tie-break or effective tick.

items: current damage per hit and exact client build for L11-15
burrow emergence, collision and 2026 skeleton targeting rules
stun magnitude at L15, application, immunity, refresh and tick order
Hero reassignment target choice and phase

conclusion: Diggy L11-15 now has dated secondary game-file level values in a hash-pinned data-only supplement and official TH18/Pet House 12 availability. Its current burrow, stun and Hero reassignment contract is incomplete, so L1-15 remains partial with no Core actor or shared adapter behavior.
